dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef001
dependency_coverage.meaning: A family of floating-point executions for a fixed certified transform plan and real parameter gamma, containing an input, one arithmetic model and one run for every positive epsilon.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The target is uniform over every such family; its input and epsilon-indexed computed errors come from this data.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef002
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the complex input vector from an execution family.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This is the input whose normalized Euclidean norm occurs in both backward-error bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef003
dependency_coverage.meaning: A certified multistage transform plan on complex vectors indexed by ZMod n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It fixes the stages, transform identities, norm-scaling facts, and constant used by the proposition.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef004
dependency_coverage.meaning: The subtype of real numbers epsilon satisfying 0 < epsilon.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The error parameter is quantified only over strictly positive real values.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef005
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a finite complex vector x, the maximum over all indices of the complex modulus |x_i|.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the infinity norm of the backward perturbation in the second bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef006
dependency_coverage.meaning: The normalized Euclidean norm N(x) = sqrt(sum_i |x_i|^2) / sqrt(n).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It measures the input, backward perturbation, and forward error in the equality and first bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef007
dependency_coverage.meaning: For an execution family and epsilon, the computed final output minus the exact unnormalized discrete Fourier transform of the input.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This is the forward-error vector required to equal the Fourier transform of a backward perturbation.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef008
dependency_coverage.meaning: The unnormalized discrete Fourier transform F defined by (Fx)_k = sum_j chi(jk)x_j, where chi is the standard additive character of ZMod n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The backward perturbation delta must satisfy F(delta) equal to the computed forward error.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef009
dependency_coverage.meaning: The plan constant K(plan,gamma) = sum_i mu(q_i,gamma) + (s-1)(3+2 gamma), where s is the stage count, q_i is stage i's radix, and mu is LocalDef017.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: K is the coefficient of the terms linear in epsilon in both bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef010
dependency_coverage.meaning: Constructs an execution family from gamma >= 0, an input, epsilon-indexed arithmetic models with model epsilon and gamma fields equal to the parameters, and runs that all use the same input.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: An existing family encodes nonnegative gamma, exact parameter matching, and a valid run for every positive epsilon.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef011
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the arithmetic model associated with each epsilon from an execution family.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It determines the floating operations used by the corresponding computed run.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef012
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the certified run associated with each epsilon from an execution family.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The target's forward error is derived from this run.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef013
dependency_coverage.meaning: Constructs a plan with positive stage count, radices whose product is n, prescribed twiddle usage, a final permutation, exact equivalence to F, stage norm scaling, surjectivity of F, and N(Fx) = sqrt(n)N(x).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: These certificates make the plan admissible and justify existence and norm scaling of Fourier preimages.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef014
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects stage i from a transform plan.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its radix enters K, and its computations determine exact and floating outputs.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef015
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the number s of stages from a transform plan.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It determines the stage index set and the term (s-1)(3+2 gamma) in K.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef016
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects a stage's natural-number radix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Each radix selects the corresponding contribution mu(q_i,gamma) to K.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef017
dependency_coverage.meaning: The stage constant mu(q,gamma): sqrt(2) if q=2, 5 if q=4, and 2 sqrt(q)(q+gamma) otherwise.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its values are summed over stages to form K.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef018
dependency_coverage.meaning: A proof that the natural number 1+1 is at least two.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports elaboration of the real numeral 2 in the stage-constant definition and adds no hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef019
dependency_coverage.meaning: For nonzero n, the universal finite set of indices ZMod n is nonempty.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes the maximum defining the infinity norm well-defined.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef020
dependency_coverage.meaning: The Euclidean norm sqrt(sum_i |x_i|^2) of a complex vector.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Dividing it by sqrt(n) defines the normalized norm used in the target.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef021
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a run, the pointwise difference between its final permuted stage state and the exact transform F of its input.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the underlying forward-error vector selected by LocalDef007.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef022
dependency_coverage.meaning: A proof that the natural number 2+1 is at least two.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports elaboration of the real numeral 3 and adds no hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef023
dependency_coverage.meaning: A two-constructor, data-free configuration tag stored in a plan.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its selected value does not occur in the target's formulas; it only participates in plan construction.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef024
dependency_coverage.meaning: A certified floating execution trace for a plan and arithmetic model.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the input and stage states from which the computed output and forward error are formed.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef025
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the input vector from a certified run.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The exact transform subtracted from the computed output is applied to this input.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef026
dependency_coverage.meaning: A transform-stage descriptor containing its radix, block decomposition, reindexing, permutation, twiddle flag, and twiddle exponents.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its data determine each exact and floating stage and the stage contributions to K.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef027
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the Boolean indicating whether a stage applies twiddle factors.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It selects whether exact and floating stage outputs are multiplied by twiddle factors.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef028
dependency_coverage.meaning: A floating arithmetic model carrying epsilon, gamma, real addition, multiplication, sine, cosine, input conversion, and their error-model certificates.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines the operations used in every epsilon-indexed run and thereby the computed error.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef029
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the epsilon field of an arithmetic model.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Execution-family construction requires it to equal the quantified positive epsilon.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef030
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the gamma field of an arithmetic model.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Execution-family construction requires it to equal the fixed gamma.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef031
dependency_coverage.meaning: A proof that the natural number 4+1 is at least two.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports elaboration of the real numeral 5 and adds no hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef032
dependency_coverage.meaning: Sequential left-to-right composition of a finite list of exact stage transforms, starting from the input.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The plan certifies that its final permutation equals the exact Fourier transform.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef033
dependency_coverage.meaning: The squared Euclidean energy sum_i |x_i|^2 of a complex vector.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its square root is the Euclidean norm used by LocalDef020.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef034
dependency_coverage.meaning: Pointwise subtraction of two complex vectors.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It forms computed output minus exact output in the forward error.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef035
dependency_coverage.meaning: The final computed vector obtained by applying the plan's final permutation to the run state after all stages.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the computed output appearing in the forward-error vector.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef036
dependency_coverage.meaning: An exact stage transform: perform the stage's block Fourier transform and then apply its optional exact twiddle factors.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Exact stage composition is certified to implement F and supplies stage norm-scaling assumptions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef037
dependency_coverage.meaning: Reindexes a vector by an equivalence p, producing the vector i maps to x(p(i)).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It applies final and stage permutations in exact and computed transforms.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef038
dependency_coverage.meaning: The first nullary constructor of the plan's two-valued configuration tag.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It has no direct occurrence in the target formula.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef039
dependency_coverage.meaning: The second nullary constructor of the plan's two-valued configuration tag.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It has no direct occurrence in the target formula.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef040
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the final index permutation from a plan.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It converts the terminal stage state into the computed final output.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef041
dependency_coverage.meaning: Constructs a run from an input and stage-state sequence, requiring exact input conversion, initial state equal to the input, and each next state equal to the modeled floating stage.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It ensures the computed output follows the specified floating algorithm and that the input is exactly represented.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef042
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the stage-state sequence from a run.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its terminal state is used to define the computed output.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef043
dependency_coverage.meaning: Constructs a stage with radix at least two, nonzero block count, blockCount times radix equal to n, reindexing and permutation equivalences, a twiddle flag, and twiddle exponents.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It restricts admissible stages and provides the data used by exact and floating stage transforms.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef044
dependency_coverage.meaning: Constructs an arithmetic model with epsilon > 0 and gamma >= 0; addition has bounded relative perturbations on each addend, multiplication has bounded relative error, and sine and cosine have bounded absolute errors gamma epsilon.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: These are the elementary rounding assumptions underlying the epsilon-linear and epsilon-squared bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef045
dependency_coverage.meaning: The exact block transform of one stage: permute the input, split indices into blocks, and apply an unnormalized radix-sized Fourier sum within each block.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the non-twiddle part of each exact stage.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef046
dependency_coverage.meaning: Applies the exact character value at each stage twiddle exponent when useTwiddle is true, and otherwise leaves the vector unchanged.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the twiddle part of each exact stage.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef047
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects a stage's block count.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It determines the block index type and satisfies blockCount times radix equal to n.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef048
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects a stage's input permutation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The stage block transform first reindexes its input using this permutation.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef049
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the equivalence between block/radix index pairs and ZMod n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It identifies each global stage index with a block and an intra-block Fourier index.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef050
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the twiddle-exponent function of a stage.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It selects the exact or computed root of unity multiplying each twiddled output.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef051
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the complex input-conversion operation from an arithmetic model.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: A valid run requires this operation to fix every component of its input exactly.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef052
dependency_coverage.meaning: Derives that every admissible stage radix is nonzero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It permits use of ZMod radix and radix-sized transform definitions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef053
dependency_coverage.meaning: A modeled floating stage: first perform the modeled block transform, then apply the modeled optional twiddle operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The run recurrence uses this operation at every stage.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef054
dependency_coverage.meaning: The modeled block transform, using specialized radix-2 or radix-4 routines when applicable and a generic modeled radix transform otherwise.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It determines the floating block computations whose errors contribute to K.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef055
dependency_coverage.meaning: Applies a modeled complex multiplication by a computed twiddle factor when useTwiddle is true, and otherwise leaves the value unchanged.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It implements floating twiddle multiplication in each stage.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef056
dependency_coverage.meaning: Modeled complex multiplication built from four modeled real multiplications and two modeled real additions, with the usual real and imaginary formulas.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is used for generic Fourier terms and twiddle products.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef057
dependency_coverage.meaning: The generic modeled unnormalized q-point Fourier transform: compute modeled roots, modeled complex products, and modeled componentwise sums.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It handles stage radices other than the specialized cases 2 and 4.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef058
dependency_coverage.meaning: Converts a proof stage.radix = 2 into the symmetric equality 2 = stage.radix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports type transport into the specialized radix-2 routine and adds no mathematical condition.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef059
dependency_coverage.meaning: Converts a proof stage.radix = 4 into the symmetric equality 4 = stage.radix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports type transport into the specialized radix-4 routine and adds no mathematical condition.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef060
dependency_coverage.meaning: A specialized modeled four-point transform using exact quarter-turn rotations and a fixed tree of modeled complex additions.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It explains the special radix-4 contribution 5 in K.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef061
dependency_coverage.meaning: A specialized modeled two-point transform using exact signs and modeled summation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It explains the special radix-2 contribution sqrt(2) in K.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef062
dependency_coverage.meaning: Computes a modeled root of unity with real part flCos(2 pi j/q) and imaginary part flSin(2 pi j/q).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies roots used in generic Fourier terms and twiddle multiplication.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef063
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects modeled real addition from an arithmetic model.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the primitive addition operation used throughout floating computations.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef064
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects modeled real cosine from an arithmetic model.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It computes real parts of modeled roots of unity.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef065
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects modeled real multiplication from an arithmetic model.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the primitive multiplication operation used in modeled complex products.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef066
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects modeled real sine from an arithmetic model.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It computes imaginary parts of modeled roots of unity.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef067
dependency_coverage.meaning: For j in ZMod 4, multiplies a complex number exactly by i^j using identity, quarter-turn, negation, or negative quarter-turn.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It provides exact root multiplications in the specialized four-point transform.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef068
dependency_coverage.meaning: For j in ZMod 2, multiplies a complex number by (-1)^j.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It provides exact signs in the specialized two-point transform.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef069
dependency_coverage.meaning: Maps j in ZMod q to the real angle 2 pi times val(j) divided by q.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the angle used to compute modeled roots of unity.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef070
dependency_coverage.meaning: Modeled complex addition obtained by applying modeled real addition separately to real and imaginary parts.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It combines terms in the specialized four-point transform.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef071
dependency_coverage.meaning: Sums a finite complex family by applying the modeled sequential real summation separately to real and imaginary components.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It performs the additions in generic and radix-2 modeled transforms.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef072
dependency_coverage.meaning: A proof that 3+1, namely 4, is nonzero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the instance needed for ZMod 4 in the specialized transform.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef073
dependency_coverage.meaning: A proof that 1+1, namely 2, is nonzero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the instance needed for ZMod 2 in the specialized transform.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef074
dependency_coverage.meaning: Sequential summation under a supplied real addition: empty sum is 0, a singleton is returned unchanged, and longer inputs are left-associated additions.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It fixes the exact evaluation order of modeled real sums.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef075
dependency_coverage.meaning: A proof that if n=0 then 0<n+1.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It discharges an index-validity obligation in sequential summation and adds no target hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef076
dependency_coverage.meaning: A dependent eliminator splitting a natural-sized vector into the zero-length and successor-length cases.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It implements the case distinction in sequential summation without changing its mathematical meaning.

dependency_coverage.name: And
dependency_coverage.meaning: Logical conjunction.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It requires all witness conditions, equalities, and paired bounds simultaneously.

dependency_coverage.name: Complex
dependency_coverage.meaning: The type of complex numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Inputs, outputs, errors, and perturbations are complex-valued vectors.

dependency_coverage.name: DivInvMonoid.toDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts the division operation from a division-inverse monoid.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies ordinary real division in normalized norms and bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: Eq
dependency_coverage.meaning: Propositional equality.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It expresses the exact Fourier representation and exact normalized-norm identity.

dependency_coverage.name: Exists
dependency_coverage.meaning: Existential quantification.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It introduces the global coefficient, radius, and epsilon-dependent perturbation.

dependency_coverage.name: HAdd.hAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: The heterogeneous addition operation selected by a typeclass.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For reals in the target it is ordinary addition.

dependency_coverage.name: HDiv.hDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: The heterogeneous division operation selected by a typeclass.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For reals in the target it is ordinary division.

dependency_coverage.name: HMul.hMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: The heterogeneous multiplication operation selected by a typeclass.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For reals it forms the products in K and the error bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: HPow.hPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: The heterogeneous exponentiation operation selected by a typeclass.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets epsilon squared in the second-order terms.

dependency_coverage.name: LE.le
dependency_coverage.meaning: The less-than-or-equal relation selected by a typeclass.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For reals it states nonnegativity, the radius condition, and both norm bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: LT.lt
dependency_coverage.meaning: The strict less-than relation selected by a typeclass.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For reals it requires positive epsilon and positive radius.

dependency_coverage.name: Monoid.toNatPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: Supplies natural-number powers from a monoid.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives ordinary real squaring for epsilon^2.

dependency_coverage.name: MulZeroClass.toZero
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts a zero element from a multiplication-with-zero structure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the zero used in the NeZero n constraint.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat
dependency_coverage.meaning: The natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The transform dimension n and stage dimensions are natural numbers.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.cast
dependency_coverage.meaning: Casts a natural number into a type with natural-number casts.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets n and stage counts as real numbers in square roots and constants.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.instMulZeroClass
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard multiplication and zero structure on natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives NeZero n its ordinary meaning n != 0.

dependency_coverage.name: NeZero
dependency_coverage.meaning: A proposition asserting that a value is not zero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It restricts the transform dimension to n != 0.

dependency_coverage.name: OfNat.ofNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: Interprets a natural-number literal in a target type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the real constants 0 and 2 and related numerals.

dependency_coverage.name: Real
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Gamma, epsilon, norms, coefficients, radii, and all bound expressions are real.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary real addition.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It combines the linear and quadratic terms in each bound.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instDivInvMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard real multiplication, inverse, and division structure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies division by sqrt(n).

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instLE
dependency_coverage.meaning: The ordinary order relation <= on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives all non-strict inequalities their standard meaning.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instLT
dependency_coverage.meaning: The ordinary strict order < on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives positivity conditions their standard meaning.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard multiplicative monoid structure on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies natural powers, including epsilon squared.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary real multiplication.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It forms products in K and both error estimates.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instNatCast
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard embedding of natural numbers into real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It turns n, stage counts, and radices into reals.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instZero
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real number zero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It occurs in positivity and nonnegativity conditions.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.sqrt
dependency_coverage.meaning: The nonnegative real square-root function.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines Euclidean norms, normalization by sqrt(n), and radix-dependent constants.

dependency_coverage.name: Subtype.val
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the underlying value from a subtype element.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It extracts the positive real value of epsilon.

dependency_coverage.name: ZMod
dependency_coverage.meaning: Integers modulo n; under n != 0 this is the finite set of n residue classes.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the index set of all complex vectors and Fourier sums.

dependency_coverage.name: Zero.toOfNat0
dependency_coverage.meaning: Interprets the numeral 0 using a type's zero element.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It produces real zero in target comparisons.

dependency_coverage.name: instHAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: Lifts homogeneous addition to heterogeneous-addition notation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It routes target additions to ordinary real addition.

dependency_coverage.name: instHDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: Lifts homogeneous division to heterogeneous-division notation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It routes target divisions to ordinary real division.

dependency_coverage.name: instHMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: Lifts homogeneous multiplication to heterogeneous-multiplication notation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It routes target products to ordinary real multiplication.

dependency_coverage.name: instHPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: Lifts a power operation to heterogeneous-power notation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It routes epsilon^2 to the ordinary natural power on reals.

dependency_coverage.name: instOfNatNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: Interprets a natural-number literal as itself in Nat.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the exponent 2 and natural constants used in definitions.

dependency_coverage.name: AddChar
dependency_coverage.meaning: An additive character from an additive monoid into a multiplicative monoid.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The Fourier kernel is represented by such a character from ZMod n to Complex.

dependency_coverage.name: AddChar.instFunLike
dependency_coverage.meaning: Coerces an additive character to its underlying function.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It allows evaluating the Fourier character at products jk.

dependency_coverage.name: AddGroupWithOne.toAddMonoidWithOne
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts additive-monoid-with-one structure from an additive group with one.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is instance plumbing for casts and arithmetic, with no extra proposition.

dependency_coverage.name: AddMonoidWithOne.toAddMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts an additive monoid from an additive monoid with one.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies inherited addition structure used by finite sums.

dependency_coverage.name: CommRing.toNonUnitalCommRing
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts nonunital commutative-ring structure from a commutative ring.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies inherited ZMod arithmetic instances without adding a hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: CommRing.toRing
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts ring structure from a commutative ring.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies inherited arithmetic and casting instances.

dependency_coverage.name: Complex.instMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary complex multiplication.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It multiplies Fourier character values by vector entries in exact transforms.

dependency_coverage.name: Complex.instNorm
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard complex modulus, sqrt(re^2+im^2).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines Euclidean energy and the infinity norm.

dependency_coverage.name: Complex.instNormedAddCommGroup
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard normed additive commutative-group structure on Complex.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies complex addition and norm compatibility used by sums and norms.

dependency_coverage.name: Complex.instNormedField
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard normed-field structure on Complex.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies standard complex arithmetic and norm instances.

dependency_coverage.name: Complex.instSemiring
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard semiring structure on Complex.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies additive and multiplicative structures for Fourier sums.

dependency_coverage.name: DFunLike.coe
dependency_coverage.meaning: Coerces a function-like object to its underlying dependent function.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It enables evaluation of characters and equivalences in transform definitions.

dependency_coverage.name: Distrib.toMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts multiplication from a distributive arithmetic structure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies inherited multiplication for complex and modular arithmetic.

dependency_coverage.name: ENormedAddCommMonoid.toESeminormedAddCommMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: Forgets definiteness from an extended normed additive commutative monoid.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is typeclass infrastructure for complex additive structure.

binders: A natural number n with n != 0.
A certified multistage transform plan plan of dimension n.
An execution family family for plan and gamma, with fixed input x : ZMod n -> Complex and one arithmetic model and valid run for every positive epsilon.
The existential coefficient C and radius r may depend on n, plan, gamma, and family.
For each positive real epsilon, the existential perturbation delta : ZMod n -> Complex may depend on epsilon and all preceding fixed data.
hypotheses: The plan has a positive number s of stages; each stage has radix q_i >= 2 and nonzero block count, the product of all q_i is n, and the plan's certified exact stage composition implements the unnormalized Fourier transform F.
The plan certifies that F is surjective and that N(Fz) = sqrt(n) N(z) for every vector z, where N is the normalized Euclidean norm.
Existence of family encodes gamma >= 0. For every epsilon > 0, its model has exactly that epsilon and the fixed gamma, and its run uses the same input x.
The model's real addition, multiplication, sine, and cosine satisfy the stated elementary error models with perturbation parameters of absolute value at most 1.
Every run starts from an exactly converted input and advances by the prescribed modeled floating stages.
conclusions: There exists a real C >= 0 and a real radius r > 0.
For every epsilon > 0, there exists a complex perturbation vector delta indexed by ZMod n.
If y_hat_epsilon is the run's computed final output and e_epsilon = y_hat_epsilon - F(x), then e_epsilon = F(delta) exactly.
The normalized norms satisfy N(delta) = N(e_epsilon) / sqrt(n) exactly.
Whenever epsilon <= r, N(delta) <= epsilon K(plan,gamma) N(x) + C epsilon^2 / sqrt(n).
Whenever epsilon <= r, ||delta||_infinity <= epsilon sqrt(n) K(plan,gamma) N(x) + C epsilon^2.
mathematical_definitions: The index set is I = ZMod n, and vectors are functions I -> Complex.
The unnormalized Fourier transform is (Fz)_k = sum_{j in I} chi(jk) z_j, where chi is the standard complex additive character of ZMod n.
The Euclidean norm is ||z||_2 = sqrt(sum_{j in I} |z_j|^2).
The normalized Euclidean norm is N(z) = ||z||_2 / sqrt(n).
The infinity norm is ||z||_infinity = max_{j in I} |z_j|.
For a run at epsilon, y_hat_epsilon is the final stage state after the plan's final permutation, and e_epsilon = y_hat_epsilon - F(x).
For radix q, mu(q,gamma) = sqrt(2) when q=2, mu(q,gamma) = 5 when q=4, and mu(q,gamma) = 2 sqrt(q)(q+gamma) otherwise.
If the plan has s stages with radices q_i, then K(plan,gamma) = sum_i mu(q_i,gamma) + (s-1)(3+2 gamma).
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every nonzero transform dimension, every certified multistage Fourier-transform plan, every real gamma, and every admissible epsilon-indexed family of floating executions for that plan, there are constants C >= 0 and r > 0, independent of epsilon, such that every positive epsilon admits a backward perturbation delta whose exact unnormalized Fourier transform is precisely the computed forward error. The perturbation's normalized Euclidean norm is exactly the forward error's normalized Euclidean norm divided by sqrt(n). For epsilon at most r, its normalized Euclidean norm is bounded by epsilon times K(plan,gamma) times the normalized input norm plus C epsilon^2/sqrt(n), and its infinity norm is bounded by epsilon sqrt(n) times K(plan,gamma) times the normalized input norm plus C epsilon^2.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: The dimension restriction n != 0 is essential; it makes ZMod n finite and nonempty and ensures sqrt(n) is a positive denominator.

Gamma is syntactically universally quantified without an explicit target hypothesis gamma >= 0, but any constructor of family contains a proof gamma >= 0. Thus the quantification over family is vacuous when no such family exists, in particular for gamma < 0.

A family must supply a valid modeled run for every positive epsilon and must use an input fixed exactly by the model's input-conversion operation. If no such family exists, the outer universal statement is vacuous.

A plan value carries strong certification assumptions, including exact implementation of F, stage norm scaling, surjectivity of F, and Fourier norm scaling. The statement says nothing about plans for which such a certificate cannot be constructed.
The bounds apply only when 0 < epsilon <= r. A perturbation and the two exact equalities are still required for epsilon > r, but neither inequality is required there.
Epsilon = 0 and negative epsilon are excluded.
The coefficient C and radius r may depend on n, the complete plan, gamma, the input, the arithmetic-model family, and its runs; no uniformity over those data is asserted.
No explicit numerical value or lower bound for r, and no explicit upper bound or formula for C, is asserted.
The epsilon-squared terms are explicit inequalities, not a little-o statement, and no behavior beyond second order is separately characterized.
The result is an absolute backward-error statement. If the input norm is zero, the linear term vanishes, but no relative error obtained by division by the input norm is asserted.
The perturbation delta is existential and is not asserted to be unique.
The exact norm identity is stated in addition to the exact Fourier-preimage equality; it relies on the normalization N(z)=||z||_2/sqrt(n) and the plan's certified Fourier scaling.
ambiguities: The supplied one-level body of the standard additive character does not expand the canonical map to the circle, so the packet fixes the Fourier kernel as chi(jk) but does not expose an explicit exponential sign convention.
The two nullary constructors of LocalDef023 have no supplied semantic labels. This does not affect the target formula because that plan field is never inspected by the proposition.
